results.title: Best display among mid-range smartphones thanks to its eye‐friendly characteristics?
results.description: With the new Xiaomi 17T, Xiaomi introduces its Vision Care technology, featuring an eye‐friendly OLED display with four TÜV certifications. The more compact 17T Pro variant is specifically aimed at users who are sensitive to PWM and experience discomfort from flicker caused by brightness control. We examine how Xiaomi’s marketing claims compare with our review results.
